description_en: Queries a DataQ - Smart Tag Service job
name: QuerySmarttagJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataQ - Smart Tag Service job to query. Get this value from the response of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163486.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的智能标签作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163486.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
Additional request parameters as a JSON string. For example: `{"labelResultType":"auto"}`. The `labelResultType` parameter is a string with these values:

auto: Machine-generated tags

hmi: Human-machine collaborative tags
parameters.help_zh:
额外的请求参数，使用JSON字符串表示，例如：`{"labelResultType":"auto"}`。其中，`labelResultType`为String类型，可取值：

auto：机器打标结果

hmi：人机协同结果
parameters.name: params

JobStatus.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

Success: The job succeeded.

Fail: The job failed.

Processing: The job is running.

Submitted: The job was submitted and is waiting to run
JobStatus.description_zh:
任务状态，可取值：

Success：处理成功。

Fail：处理失败。

Processing：处理中。

Submitted：已提交等待处理

UserData.description_en: Information passed through when using MNS callbacks. For the message format, see Callback message format definition below
UserData.description_zh: 通过MNS回调时透传回来的信息。消息格式请参见下文回调消息格式定义
